title: Bleak and Grim
description: Vanilla worldgen without the joy and whimsy.
body: This datapack transforms Minecraft’s overworld into a more desolate and hostile landscape by removing all cheerful, lush, and brightly colored biomes. Gone are the vibrant forests, sunny plains, and warm tropical zones, replaced instead with a world dominated by bleak, harsh environments. What few villages remain are zombified, the pillagers have spread their influence throughout more biomes, and even the safe haven of the mushroom island has become a hauntingly barren plane of a void biome. Good luck, and feel free to play in Large Biomes mode for a slightly more challenging experience.
